<!--
  This template is written for the public read-only mirror (github.com/tnzi/Tnzi.NET).
  It also lives in the upstream private repo because the mirror is a projection of it.
-->

## This repository cannot accept pull requests

Tnzi.NET is developed in a private repository. What you see here is a projection of its
framework code, resynced by an allow-list. Each sync replaces the tree wholesale, so a
commit merged here would be silently overwritten and would never reach upstream.

**Please open an issue instead.** Describe the problem or the change you want; that reaches
the people who can act on it.

## If you have already written the fix

Don't throw it away. Open an issue and include either the diff or a link to your fork. The
change will be implemented upstream and credited to you in the commit message, then it
arrives here with the next sync.

Under Apache-2.0 (section 5), anything you submit is licensed under the same terms unless
you say otherwise, so code shared this way can be used directly.

## What does get read

Issues. Bug reports, missing capabilities, unclear documentation, API design objections.
Objections are especially welcome: this framework's sharper edges were mostly found by
consuming applications refusing to adopt something.
